notes.title: Dev Update!
notes.notes:
Dev update!


Hey everyone! Frankie here 😊 We’ve made some great progress since launching the Steam page, both on Super Carpark and a few other exciting projects. I'll quickly sum up ever thing that's been going on.


- Join Our Discord!

We’ve set up a community Discord and would love to hang out, chat, and hear your thoughts: https://discord.gg/7ChNhjwJjx


- New Project Demo: Pigeon Hunter
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3917020/Pigeon_Hunter/"][/dynamiclink]We’ve just launched a demo for a brand new project called Pigeon Hunter! It’s available across multiple platforms, but here’s the Steam link 👆

It’s a special collaboration with my mum (yes, really!) so go check it out, and if you like it, don’t forget to wishlist it!


- Squash and Spell Beta Now Supports Custom Voice Clips!
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3387970/Squash_and_Spell__Kids_Typing/"][/dynamiclink]This one’s close to my heart, I made it for my daughter when she was little and wanted to mash keys like me. Now, anyone can add their own words and voice clips! Just drop a .wav file into a folder. It can be any language, as long as the words use the modern English alphabet and are 7 letters or fewer.


- Super Carpark Walking Parking Simulator Turbo Updates! 
This game has been great fun to work on so far,  thank you all for the awesome feedback! 

We’ve now added a roguelike deck-building system. It might sound crazy, but it fits perfectly. The goal has always been fun and chaos, and with cards you can now customize the experience:

Too fast? Pick a Walk Slower card.

Too easy? Add more cars with a Spawn More card.

Too boring? Cars are on fire or have rainbow trails.



We’re also working on:

A story mode, where the carpark goes on an adventure

An arcade mode with high scores.

Steam integration (leaderboards and achievements are live!)

New environments: We’ve started on a country road setting, with suburbs and beaches on the way


Thanks so much for sticking with us, can’t wait to show you more soon!



– Frankie 🚗🅿️
